notes: Markush reference to the patent's general formula (I); the section names no specific compound, so it stays unresolved. Printed as Verbindungen der Formel (I), without allgemeinen. Merged from line 396 (Die erfindungsgemäßen Verbindungen der Formel (I)), line 409 (die erfindungsgemäßen Verbindungen) and line 413 (Die vorliegenden Verbindungen); line 396 also refers to the same compounds as die Substanzen. Line 396 prints the catchword Die erfindungsgemäßen Verbindungen twice in succession before the sentence continues; reproduced as printed and not corrected. The section states only herbicidal effect and crop selectivity, so no quantity, characterisation or structural tag is supported. The weed and crop genera named in the section (Avena, Lolium, Echinochloa, Galium, wheat, barley, rye, rice, maize, sugar beet, cotton, soya and the rest) are organisms, not compounds, and are not emitted.

Anaphoric reference to the compounds of the formula (I) of the invention, printed as die Wirkstoffe (line 396), den erfindungsgemäßen Wirkstoffen (line 407) and der Wirkstoffe (line 411); the dative and genitive forms are kept in aliases as printed rather than normalised. Kept as a separate record from compound of the formula (I) because it is a distinct surface reference in this section; the section itself equates the two, and neither identifies a specific compound, so both are unresolved. Wirkstoff is a functional term (active ingredient) and guarantees nothing structural, so no chemical_family or functional_group tag is emitted.
